items.title: October 10, 1982: Dave Cowens makes his Milwaukee Bucks debut in an NBA Preseason game at Phoenix.
items.author: NBA Cobwebs
items.body_excerpt:
October 10, 1982: Dave Cowens makes his Milwaukee Bucks debut in an NBA Preseason game at Phoenix.

The 33-year-old Cowens—who'd been retired for two full NBA seasons—scored 4 PTS and grabbed 2 REB in 17 minutes. The Suns' Walter Davis scored 16 PTS in a 117-114 victory.

items.title: No NBA team has won back-to-back championships since 2018.
items.author: Tommy Beer
items.body_excerpt:
No NBA team has won back-to-back championships since 2018.

In fact, no defending champ has even made it back to the Finals since the Warriors in 2019.

Incredibly, the OKC Thunder last season were the first defending champs to even advance to the Conference Finals!
